Rashi on Chullin 58b:10:1.hebrew: מלמטה - סמוך לנקב הרעי מתחברין, כדי שיהא הרעי יוצא ממקום אחד:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:10:1.english: Below - Close to the orifice of the excrement they join together, so that the excrement emerges from one place.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:11:1.hebrew: ר' יהודה - הא דאמר, דחשיב לה כגלודה שניטל עורה. ורבי ישמעאל נמי חשיב לנוצה כעור, דאמר: נוצה מצטרפת לכזית לפגל בחטאת העוף, אם מלקה ע"מ לאכול כזית בין נוצה ועור ובשר, חוץ לזמנו:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:11:1.english: Rabbi Yehuda - That which he said [is because] he considers it like a flayed [animal] whose hide was removed. And Rabbi Yishmael also considers down like hide, as he said: The down joins to [constitute] an olive-bulk to render [it] piggul in [the case of] a bird sin-offering, if he pinched its nape with the intention to eat an olive-bulk — [combined] from down, skin, and meat — beyond its [designated] time.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:12:2.english: Only with regard to piggul - For he holds that [the down] is fit for consumption.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:12:3.english: Does not protect - And even if it is removed, it also does not matter to us.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:13:1.english: Congested with blood - That blood seized it and it became ill:

Rashi on Chullin 58b:13:2.english: And that was smoked - Smoke entered its body.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:13:3.english: And that was chilled - An illness due to cold. Oleander - A deadly poison for an animal.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:13:5.english: [If] it ate deadly poison - That is a deadly poison to humans.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:14:1.hebrew: קורט של חלתית - חד הוא, ונוקב את בני המעים. חלתית — לזר"א:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:14:1.english: A sliver of asafoetida - It is sharp, and perforates the intestines. Asafoetida [is] laser [in Old French].

Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:1.hebrew: תיעא - תור"א בלע"ז, ועשב מר הוא מאד. וכל אלו קשין לה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:1.english: Tia - Tore in Old French [crowfoot], and it is a very bitter herb; and all these are harmful to [the animal].

Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:2.hebrew: כלב שוטה - אמרינן בסדר יומא (דף פג:), רוח רעה שורה עליו, וכשנושך אדם — שורה עליו והורגתו:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:2.english: A mad dog - We say in Tractate Yoma (83b) that an evil spirit rests upon it, and when it bites a person, [the evil spirit] rests upon him and kills him.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:3.english: Asafoetida poses a difficulty - [The statement] here against [the statement regarding] asafoetida of Shmuel.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:4.hebrew: וקשיא סם המות - דהכא אסם המות דמתני':
Rashi on Chullin 58b:15:4.english: And deadly poison poses a difficulty - [The statement] here [poses a difficulty] to [the statement regarding] deadly poison in the Mishnah.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:16:1.hebrew: הא דידה - ברייתא בסם המות דבהמה, שאינו סם המות לאדם:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:16:1.english: This [refers to poison deadly] to itself - The baraita [is dealing] with a poison deadly to an animal, which is not a deadly poison to a person.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:16:2.english: [With] two types of deadly poison - The *tanna* of the *baraita* is dealing with [poison that is deadly to] an animal.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:1:1.hebrew: הני תמרי דכדא - שהתליעו, ואין ידוע אם במחובר אם בתלוש:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:1:1.english: These dates in a jar - That became worm-infested, and it is not known whether [they became infested while] attached [to the tree] or [while] detached.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:1:2.hebrew: לבתר תריסר ירחי שתא שריין - דאי במחובר התליע, לא הוי חיי עד השתא:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:1:2.english: After twelve months of the year they are permitted - For if it became infested while attached [to the tree], [the worm] would not have lived until now.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:2:1.hebrew: בקא - מין זבוב, צינציל"א, והיא נושכת כצרעה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:2:1.english: A mosquito - A type of fly, cincelle [in Old French], and it bites like a wasp.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:1.hebrew: אימרא - לשון (איוב לט) "כעת במרום תמריא" — נתנכרה לו ומרדה עליו, אינשלביי"ר:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:1.english: Revolted - An expression [related to]: “When she soars on high” (Job 39:18) — she became estranged from him and rebelled against him [Old French: ensalveier, to turn wild].

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:2.hebrew: לבר מחוזא - על שם שהיו בני מחוזא מעונגים ושמנים, נאמר משל זה עליהם:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:2.english: A resident of Meḥoza - Because the people of Meḥoza were pampered and fat, this proverb was said about them.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:3.english: And sucked from him - Blood; [that is,] you sucked his blood.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:4.english: Minas - A weight of sixty minas.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:5.hebrew: בקורנסיה - מרטי"ל. כלומר, הוי זהיר בו, שנשיכתו כבדה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:5.english: In its mallet - [*Martel*, Old French for a hammer.] That is to say: Be careful of it, for its bite is heavy.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:6.hebrew: במני דידהו - במשקל שלהן של בקי, שהוא קל:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:6.english: In their own manehs - In their measure of weight, [that] of mosquitoes, which is light.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:3:7.english: In their own years - They are [mere] moments.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:1.english: We learned there - In [tractate] Bekhorot, regarding blemishes.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:2.hebrew: לא שנו - דקתני הרי זה מום לגבוה, הא להדיוט שרי:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:2.english: They taught only - That it teaches [that] this is a blemish for the Most High, but for an ordinary person it is permitted:

Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:3.hebrew: אלא שחסר ויתר ביד - שחסור זה דבעלת שלש, או יתור זה דבעלת ה', ביד — שאין לה אלא יד אחד, או שיש לה ג' ידים:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:3.english: Only where it was missing or had an additional [limb] in the foreleg - That this deficiency of [the animal] with three [legs], or this excess of [the animal] with five [legs], is in the foreleg — that it has only one foreleg, or that it has three forelegs.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:4.hebrew: כנטול דמי - יתר אחד כחסר אחד, והויא כבעלת רגל אחד, וטרפה — דהויא כשמוטת ירך בבהמה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:4:4.english: Is considered like a removed [limb] - An extra [limb] is like a missing [limb], and [so] it is like [an animal] with [only] one hind leg, and [therefore] it is a tereifa, for it is like [the case of] a dislocated thigh in an animal.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:5:1.english: Sanya devei - They call it boudel crestinee [in Old French, i.e., the cecum].

Rashi on Chullin 58b:6:1.english: A tube - Like a tube of flesh.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:6:2.english: That passed from the reticulum to the hovlila - [That is, the] omasum.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:1.english: To deem it kosher - Just as we deemed [it] kosher in [the case of] the tube between the reticulum and the omasum.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:2.hebrew: בחדא מחיתא מחתינהו - וכי באריגה אחת ארגתם לכולם? לשון (שמות לט בתרגום) "עובד מחי" — דתיקון דבור קרו לו אינשי אריגה, שמסדר את דבריו:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:2.english: Did you weave them in one weave - Did you weave all of them in one weave? [This is] an expression [similar to] (Exodus 39 in the Targum) "oved meḥei" [woven work] — for people call the formulation of speech "weaving", as one arranges his words.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:3.hebrew: היכא דאיתמר - דברייתא הכי אית להו, איתמר:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:3.english: Where it was stated - [Where] it was stated that wild animals have this [structure], it was stated:

Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:4.hebrew: והיכא דלא איתמר לא איתמר - ויתר הוא, וכאילו ניטל אחד מן המעים כנגדו הוא, דכל יתר כנטול דמי. וכן הלכה, דליכא מאן דפליג. ואע"ג דאמרן (לעיל חולין דף מז.) באוני דריאה: "לית הלכתא כוותיה דרבא ביתרת" — הא אוקימנא: והוא דקיימא בדרא דאוני, דקים להו לרבנן דאורחייהו בהכי; אבל ביני ביני — טרפה, אלמא כנטול דמי. וגבי רגלים, דלאו אורחייהו — ודאי טרפה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:7:4.english: And where it was not stated, it was not stated - And it is superfluous, and it is as though one of the intestines corresponding to it was removed, for any superfluous [organ] is considered as removed. And such is the halakha, as there is no one who disagrees. And even though we said (above, Chullin 47a) regarding the lobes of the lung, "The halakha is not in accordance with Rava regarding a superfluous [lobe]" — behold, we established: That is [only] when it stands in the row of the lobes, as it is established to the Sages that this is their normal way; but [if it is located] in between, [the animal is] a tereifa. Evidently, [a superfluous organ] is considered as removed; and regarding legs, where [an extra one] is not their normal way, [the animal is] certainly a tereifa.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:8:1.hebrew: היוצאים מן הבהמה כאחד - דאית לה תרתי הדורי דכנתא, ושניהם יוצאין מן הקיבה — זה בראשה וזה באמצעה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:8:1.english: That exit from the animal as one - That it has two [sets of] intestinal coils, and both of them exit from the abomasum — one at its head and one at its middle.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:8:2.hebrew: וכנגדן בעוף כשרה - דעוף זימנין דהוי הכי, ואע"ג דלא משתכח להו, הכי קים להו. ויש מפרשין, שכל עוף דרכו כן, משום דמן הזפק ועד הקורקבן קנה של מעיין אחד, וההוא קרי בני מעים, ובראש הקורקבן יוצאין בני מעים גמורין:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:8:2.english: And corresponding to them in a bird, it is kosher - For in a bird, sometimes it happens like this; and even though it is not [frequently] found by them, thus it is established for them [by tradition]. And some explain that every bird's standard manner is so, because from the crop to the gizzard [there is] a single intestinal duct, and that is called intestines, and at the top of the gizzard the actual intestines emerge:

Rashi on Chullin 58b:8:3.english: But [if] they exit from one place - Adjacent to each other.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:8:4.english: And they end within a fingerbreadth - And they return and merge within the width of a fingerbreadth.

Rashi on Chullin 58b:9:1.hebrew: פליגי בה - בהיכא דיוצאים ממקום אחד, דקתני כשרה:
Rashi on Chullin 58b:9:1.english: They disagree with regard to it - In [a case] where they emerge from one place, concerning which it was taught [that it is] kosher:

Tosafot on Chullin 58b:11:1.hebrew: הנוצה מצטרפת - פ"ה: לענין פגול, וגריס: "אבל לענין פגול כרבנן סבירא ליה". ור"ת אומר שהוא משנה בטהרות (פ"א מ"ב): "הכנפים והנוצה מטמאות ומיטמאות ולא מצטרפין, רבי ישמעאל אומר: הנוצה מצטרפת". פירוש: מצטרפת לכביצה, דשומר הוא. ותנן במסכת עוקצין (פ"א מ"א): "כל שהוא יד ואינו שומר — טמא ומטמא ולא מצטרף; שומר, אפילו שאינו יד — טמא ומצטרף". והשתא מייתי ראיה מדחשיב ליה כשומר לבשר, אלמא הוי כמו עור, וכשניטלה — כאילו ניטל העור, דהוי גלודה וטרפה. ורבא דחי: עד כאן לא קאמר רבי יהודה אלא לענין אגוני, אבל שומר לבשר לא חשיב — שאין רגילות להצניע העוף עם הנוצה שלא יתלכלך; ועד כאן לא קאמר ר' ישמעאל אלא לענין טומאה דחשיב שומר, אבל לענין אגוני — לא מגין:
Tosafot on Chullin 58b:11:1.english: "The down joins" - Rashi explained: [This is] with regard to piggul, and he reads [the text of the Gemara as]: "But with regard to piggul, he holds in accordance with the Rabbis." And Rabbeinu Tam says that it is a mishna in Tohorot (1:2): "The wings and the down convey ritual impurity and contract ritual impurity, but do not join [with the meat]. Rabbi Yishmael says: The down joins." Explanation: It joins [with the meat] to [complete] an egg-bulk, because it is a protective covering [for the meat]. And we learned in tractate Okatzin (1:1): "Anything that is a handle and not a protective covering contracts ritual impurity and conveys ritual impurity, but does not join; a protective covering, even if it is not a handle, contracts ritual impurity and joins." And now [according to Rabbeinu Tam, the Gemara] brings a proof from [the fact] that it considers it a protective covering for the meat; evidently, it is like hide, and when it is removed, it is as if the hide were removed, such that it is flayed and a tereifa. And Rava refutes [this]: Rabbi Yehuda said [his statement] only with regard to protecting [the bird's life], but it is not considered a protective covering for the meat, as it is not customary to store a fowl with the down so that it does not become dirty; and Rabbi Yishmael said [his statement] only with regard to ritual impurity, where it is considered a protective covering, but with regard to protecting [the bird's life], it does not protect.

Tosafot on Chullin 58b:1:1.hebrew: הני תמרי דכדא לבתר תריסר ירחי שתא שרי - רבינו שמואל גריס: "דכרים", פירוש: שהתליעו, כמו "ענבי דכרום ושדה שלקתה בעמרים" בפרק המקבל (ב"מ דף קו: ע"ש), ובנזיר בריש גמרא פרק שלשה מינים (נזיר דף לד:): "לאתויי ענבים דכרום", ובאמצע הפרק זה (דף לח:): "והא שייר ענבים דכרום"; שהרי אין דרך פירות להניח בכד, ועוד — דהוה ליה למימר שהתליעו. ור"ת מפרש: שדרך להניח כל דבר בכד, כדאיתא בפ' חזקת הבתים (ב"ב דף נה.): "הני שערי דכדא משתעבדי לכרגא", ובהמפקיד (ב"מ דף מ.): "הוה עובדא ופקע כדא", ובפ' הזהב (בבא מציעא דף נט.): "במשלם שערי מכדא נקיט ואתי תיגרא":
Tosafot on Chullin 58b:1:1.english: "These dates of a jar are permitted after twelve months of the year" - Rabbeinu Shmuel reads [the text as] dekharim, explanation: [meaning] that they became wormy, like "grapes that became wormy [invei dekhrom] and a field that was blighted in its sheaves" in the chapter [entitled] HaMekabel (Bava Metzia 106b; see there), and in Nazir at the beginning of the Gemara of the chapter [entitled] Sheloshah Minim (Nazir 34b): "to include grapes that became wormy," and in the middle of this chapter (38b): "And doesn't it omit grapes that became wormy?"; for it is not customary to place fruit in a jar, and furthermore, [the Gemara] should have said "that became wormy." And Rabbeinu Tam explains that it is customary to place anything in a jar, as it is stated in the chapter [entitled] Chezkhat HaBatim (Bava Batra 55a): "This barley of a jar is encumbered to the poll tax," and in [the chapter entitled] HaMafkid (Bava Metzia 40a): "There was an incident where a jar burst," and in the chapter [entitled] HaZahav (Bava Metzia 59a): "When the barley is finished from the jar, strife comes knocking."
